about: Garment presets: the tuned numbers that cut, fit and hide one garment, so a build script names a preset instead of holding them. wardrobe.dress(body, preset) runs tailor -> paint_ease (if any) -> ease -> skin -> hem (if any) -> cover -> spec -> export with them. `cut` is tailor.shirt, tailor.pants, tailor.skirt or tailor.dress; `tailor`, `paint`, `ease`, `hem` and `cover` are that call's keyword arguments (null: the step is skipped); `soft` is the follow-through cloth arguments a skirt or dress takes with dress(..., soft=True); `layer_cover` is cover.compute's arguments for what the garment hides of each garment worn under it; `spec_kind` and `layer` go to spec.build; `colour` is linear RGB; `worn_over` names the presets this one is fitted over when they are worn; `note` says where the numbers came from.

sports_top.name: SportsTop
sports_top.note: Belle's (grungist-creek assets/belle/build_belle.py). Fitted athletic wear: a few millimetres of ease, nothing hanging. Cut sleeveless from the shoulder, its neckline over the top of the bust and its band on the ribs well below the fold under the bust: at the fold itself the skin kept drawn along the hem (cover's 3 cm margin) came through it in Godot. Relaxed over 80 passes to span the cleavage it pulled in over the nipples and fold and let skin through - ease's default 16 iterations kept. Cover agree 0.7, margin 3 cm.

shorts_mid_thigh.name: Shorts
shorts_mid_thigh.note: Belle's (build_belle.py). Fitted athletic shorts: a few millimetres of ease, nothing hanging. They sit on the hips and reach a third of the way down the thigh, past the gluteal fold. Cover agree 0.7, margin 3 cm.

briefs.name: Briefs
briefs.note: Nora's underwear (grungist-creek assets/wardrobe/build_outfits.py), layer 1: 2.5 mm off the skin and nothing hanging, the leg opening rising 40 degrees toward the hip. Cover at wardrobe's defaults.

bra.name: Bra
bra.note: Nora's underwear (build_outfits.py), layer 1: 2.5 mm off the skin and nothing hanging, sleeveless and cut high. Cover at wardrobe's defaults. Nora's build also averages the armpit weights of every shirt with the project's build_person.smooth_weights; dress does not.

shorts.name: Shorts
shorts.note: Nora's (build_outfits.py), layer 2, worn instead of trousers: loose cotton shorts that hang, loosening over 7 cm toward the leg openings, with sprung leg hems backstopped against the briefs. Eased at least 3 mm outside the briefs and hiding what it covers of them (4 cm gap, 1.5 cm margin).

trousers.name: Trousers
trousers.note: Nora's (build_outfits.py), layer 2, worn instead of shorts: denim to the ankle, the legs loosening over their lower 30 cm, sprung leg hems backstopped against the briefs. Eased at least 3 mm outside the briefs and hiding what it covers of them.

tshirt.name: Tshirt
tshirt.note: Nora's (build_outfits.py), layer 3, worn instead of the longsleeve: a jersey T-shirt hanging from the widest point, ease painted at wardrobe's defaults (1 at the hem, 0.3 at the cuffs), 8 hem and 4 cuff bones backstopped against what is under it. Eased at least 3 mm outside the bra and the shorts or trousers and hiding what it covers of each. Nora's build also averages the armpit weights with the project's build_person.smooth_weights; dress does not.

longsleeve.name: Longsleeve
longsleeve.note: Nora's (build_outfits.py), layer 3, worn instead of the T-shirt: wool with sleeves near the wrist, the cuffs eased less than the default (0.2, not 0.3), 8 hem and 4 cuff bones. Eased at least 3 mm outside what is under it and hiding what it covers of each. Nora's build also averages the armpit weights with the project's build_person.smooth_weights; dress does not.

skirt_knee.name: Skirt
skirt_knee.note: Built round the body (tailor.skirt), not cut from it: waistband 0.16 torso lengths above the hips, 5 mm snug there, 15 mm ease from the widest hip level down, hem at 0.85 of the way to the knee with 1.3x the widest hip girth. 12 poplin hem bones hung from the thighs. Measured in Godot on Mei, Nadia and Rosa (character-pipeline crowd bodies), walk, run and crouch: at most 4 of 1024-1088 vertices inside a thigh (0.37%), no holes, poke under 0.12%; skinned to the pelvis alone (rigid=spine) the crouch put 149-162 inside. At length 1.05 the back hem was caught between calf and thigh in a run and crouch. Cover: no skin below the hip joints or facing forward is hidden (margin 5 cm), so it hides almost nothing (2-18 triangles); a hidden front belly showed above the waistband in a crouch. soft=True routes it to follow-through cotton cloth pinned at the hips.

skirt_mini.name: Skirt
skirt_mini.note: The skirt build as skirt_knee with a denim hem at 0.45 along the thigh, 1.4x the hip girth, 12 hem bones. At flare 1.2 a crouch put 6 of 704 vertices inside a thigh on Nadia (0.85%) and 4 of 640 on Rosa; at 1.4, 2 and 3, and none of walk, run or crouch on Mei, Nadia or Rosa fails. In a stride it follows each thigh closely and reads nearer shorts than a flared mini.

dress_sleeveless.name: Dress
dress_sleeveless.note: A sleeveless bodice cut from the body down to the natural waist (0.30 torso lengths above the hips, eased 8 mm and hung), zipped to a skirt built from its hem to 0.85 of the way to the knee at 1.3x the widest hip girth, 12 poplin hem bones. Cover hides the bodice's skin as a shirt's, and below the waist the skirt rule (no front-facing skin, nothing below the hip joints). Walk, run and crouch pass on Mei, Nadia and Rosa: at most 8 of 2420-2537 vertices inside a thigh (0.33%), no holes, poke at most 0.23% (upper arms at the armholes). At length 1.0 a run put 14-16 inside the shins.
